items: Fast, responsive guest communication gets harder as you add locations or franchise, which is where AI customer support software earns its place.
Look for one inbox that brings messages from email, chat, social media and reviews together, so your team replies from a single place.
Good AI support resolves common issues automatically and hands harder ones to a teammate with full context, so guests never have to repeat themselves.
Check which kind of business each platform is built for, and whether it connects to the CRM and other systems you already use.
Momos is built for restaurants: its Alfie agent resolves and personalizes guest recoveries, and Rockie turns reviews and conversations into insights by location.
